Next steps I suggest: if youd like the upgrade we can: (1) lock price and prepare an amendment/SOW, (2) finalize legal and billing, and (3) target swap-over at renewal (May 1) or accelerate earlier if you need capacity immediately.

Looping in Laura, Rishi and Priyom for pricing/sow and technical confirmations. Happy to jump on a 30m call this week if useful.

Hi Matthew — quick technical note based on your usage profile: 512-token average sequences, primarily scoring jobs with periodic bursts.

- Expected performance: moving from 8→16 reserved GPUs typically reduces queue depth by ~55–65% for your workload mix and improves tail (95th) generation latency by ~30–45% on the same GPU family (measured on A100-class). Thats consistent with your historical token mix and prefix/cache hit rates.
- Throughput: steady-state throughput should rise roughly 1.8–2.2x depending on KV cache hit-rate and batching policy; we can tune batch magnitude to keep single-request latency within your SLOs.
- Guarantees: we can offer a latency SLO for 95th percentile P95 of your typical scoring runs when pinned to the reserved pool; if we miss the SLO by more than 10% in a given month, we can apply service credits up to 10% of that months reserved fee (subject to monitoring instrumentation and mutually agreed-upon test prompts).
- Early ramp: for Apr 22 we can open a temporary burst allocation (pre-paid) to avoid queuing; minimal lead time — wed need confirmation by EOD Apr 15 to ensure the orchestration and KV warms.

Ill attach a short SOW and an implementation note that spells out GPU family, monitoring hooks, and rollback/fallback policies.

Regards,
